_source: The attic spider (sprint 001, phase F, user brief 2026-11-25 items 8-11). kind: the furniture piece (furniture.json, attic). reach_m: how near the ghost must be to trade (metres). give: what the spider asks (item -> units); get: what it gives. 'Six flies for spider nests' (brief): one nest per six flies is a provisional reading; change get to give more.
_ecology: Sprint 002 (P2, task S2-03, user brief track C, 2026-11-26): the trade is the feeding (D4). ecology: calories_per_fly, decay_per_day (game days), grown_at (bigger, warning, still trades), hostile_at (hostile; calories capped here), hostile_days, recover_per_day (after hostility), calm_at (friendly again), size_min/size_max (drawing scale, linear in calories up to hostile_at). Targets (checked by tests/integration/data/spider_data_test.gd): one trade a day turns it hostile in 4-6 trades; one every other day never does. web: range_m (attic floor metres), cooldown_seconds / telegraph_seconds (real seconds at any game speed, stopped while paused), speed_mps, hit_radius_m, damage_pct (of the ghost's maximum energy), max_hits_per_day (per game day). A hidden ghost or one outside the attic is never attacked. All values provisional.
_behaviour: Sprint 002 (P4, S2-05, user brief B3): how it moves, in real seconds. react_m: the ghost this near (metres, not hidden) makes it lower itself; drop_px: how far down (pixels at depth 1); descend_seconds: the time to go all the way down or up; return_delay_seconds: how long the ghost must be away before it climbs back; feed_seconds: the eating animation after a trade.
